title: From Stability to Inconsistency: A Study of Moral Preferences in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to a novel dataset of 1,079 real-world moral dilemmas (MFD-LLM) using single, pair, triple, and total preference setups to measure alignment with the six core foundations of Moral Foundations Theory (Authority, Care, Fairness, Liberty, Loyalty, Sanctity).

Analyzing the homogeneity of LLMs' moral preferences and identifying a systematic bias where model outputs predominantly align with the values of WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialised, Rich, and Democratic) cultures.
